name: ollama
author: ollama
description: The local LLM runtime everything else on the box talks to: Open WebUI chats through it and n8n workflows call it. Runs as a systemd *user* unit bound to 127.0.0.1:11434 only — never published through Tailscale Serve — so the launcher and the ntfy controller start, stop and restart it like any other service (it used to be a system unit, which is why they could not). Models live in ~/.ollama/models; a loaded one claims roughly 5 GB of the box's 7.7 GB. No web UI of its own, so this tile reports status and never navigates.
